offering_description.value: Provides cloud-based telecommunications services, including hosted business phone systems and unified communications, plus collaboration software, to small and mid-sized businesses. Also sells these services through channel partners under white-label arrangements. Delivered through its own cloud platform with subscription billing.

primary_products.value: cloud telephony software platform; IP desk phones and handsets; video collaboration software

primary_services.value: hosted business phone service (UCaaS); unified communications and collaboration; contact center services; network and managed services; white-label telecom platform services

customer_segment.value: B2B: small and mid-sized businesses, enterprises, and channel partners and resellers of white-label service

end_markets.value: small and medium business; enterprise communications; telecommunications; professional services

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly recurring cloud telecommunications and software service fees; product sales: phones and telecom equipment sold to customers; licensing or royalties: platform software licenses and fees from white-label partners; service fees: installation, professional and support services
revenue_model.category: subscription; product sales; licensing or royalties; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: operates a cloud communications platform sold to businesses and channel partners; service provider: delivers hosted voice and unified communications services to business customers

geography_served.value: US national: customers across the United States, with some international partners

specialization.value: related lines: cloud telecommunications services and software platform sold to businesses and channel partners

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales team selling to businesses; partners / resellers: channel partners and white-label resellers such as agents and telecom providers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: telecom and VoIP rules including FCC requirements, 911 obligations, state regulation and data privacy rules

notes: Details of current product mix are from memory and may be slightly outdated.
